name: cerberus
description: Group containing cerberus-related configuration options

name: cerberus-enabled
description: Enables Cerberus Support

name: cerberus-url
description: Cerberus http url

name: kraken
description: Group containing core krkn run configuration options

name: krkn-kubeconfig
description: Sets the path where krkn will search for kubeconfig (in container)

name: generate-pdf-report
description: Generates a PDF report summarizing the chaos run results at the end of each scenario

name: generate-html-report
description: Generate an interactive HTML summary report after the chaos run

name: krkn-debug
description: Enables debug mode for Krkn

name: tunings
description: Group containing chaos scenario timing and repetition configuration options

name: wait-duration
description: waits for a certain amount of time after the scenario

name: iterations
description: number of times the same chaos scenario will be executed

name: daemon-mode
description: if set the scenario will execute forever

name: prometheus
description: Group containing prometheus monitoring and alerting configuration options

name: prometheus-url
description: Prometheus url for when running on kuberenetes

name: prometheus-token
description: Prometheus bearer token for prometheus url authentication

name: uuid
description: sets krkn run uuid instead of generating it

name: capture-metrics
description: Enables metrics capture

name: enable-alerts
description: Enables cluster alerts check

name: alerts-path
description: Allows to specify a different alert file path

name: metrics-path
description: Allows to specify a different metrics file path

name: check-critical-alerts
description: Enables checking for critical alerts

name: elasticsearch
description: Group containing elasticsearch data collection and indexing configuration options

name: enable-es
description: Enables elastic search data collection

name: es-run-tag
description: Elasticsearch run tag to compare similar runs

name: es-server
description: Elasticsearch instance URL

name: es-port
description: Elasticsearch instance port

name: es-username
description: Elasticsearch instance username

name: es-password
description: Elasticsearch instance password

name: es-verify-certs
description: Enables elasticsearch TLS certificate verification

name: es-metrics-index
description: Index name for metrics in Elasticsearch

name: es-alerts-index
description: Index name for alerts in Elasticsearch

name: es-telemetry-index
description: Index name for telemetry in Elasticsearch

name: telemetry
description: Group containing telemetry data collection and backup configuration options

name: telemetry-enabled
description: Enables telemetry support

name: telemetry-api-url
description: API endpoint for telemetry data

name: telemetry-username
description: Username for telemetry authentication

name: telemetry-password
description: Password for telemetry authentication

name: telemetry-prometheus-backup
description: Enables Prometheus backup for telemetry

name: telemetry-full-prometheus-backup
description: Enables full Prometheus backup for telemetry

name: telemetry-backup-threads
description: Number of threads for telemetry backup

name: telemetry-archive-path
description: Path to save telemetry archive

name: telemetry-max-retries
description: Maximum retries for telemetry operations

name: telemetry-run-tag
description: Tag for telemetry run

name: telemetry-group
description: Group name for telemetry data

name: telemetry-archive-size
description: Maximum size for telemetry archives in KB

name: telemetry-logs-backup
description: Enables logs backup for telemetry

name: telemetry-filter-pattern
description: Filter pattern for telemetry logs

name: telemetry-cli-path
description: Path to telemetry CLI tool (oc)

name: telemetry-events-backup
description: Enables events backup for telemetry

name: health_check
description: Group containing health check URL monitoring configuration options

name: health-check-interval
description: How often to check the health check urls (seconds)

name: health-check-url
description: Url to check the health of

name: health-check-auth
description: Authentication tuple to authenticate into health check URL

name: health-check-bearer-token
description: Bearer token to authenticate into health check URL

name: health-check-exit
description: Exit on failure when health check URL is not able to connect

name: health-check-verify
short_description: SSL Verification of health check url
description: SSL Verification to authenticate into health check URL

name: kubevirt
description: Group containing KubeVirt VM monitoring and check configuration options

name: kubevirt-check-interval
description: How often to check the KubeVirt VMs SSH status (seconds)

name: kubevirt-namespace
description: KubeVirt namespace to check the health of

name: kubevirt-name
description: KubeVirt regex names to check VMs

name: kubevirt-only-failures
short_description: KubeVirt checks only report if failure occurs
description: KubeVirt checks only report if failure occurs

name: kubevirt-disconnected
description: KubeVirt checks in disconnected mode, bypassing the cluster API

name: kubevirt-ssh-node
description: KubeVirt backup node to SSH into when checking VMI IP address status

name: kubevirt-exit-on-failure
short_description: KubeVirt fail if failed vms at end of run
description: KubeVirt fails run if vms still have false status

name: kubevirt-node-name
short_description: KubeVirt node to filter vms on
description: Only track VMs in KubeVirt on given node name

name: kubevirt-label-selector
short_description: KubeVirt label selector to filter vms
description: Label selector to filter VMs in KubeVirt

name: resiliency
description: Group containing resiliency score calculation configuration options

name: resiliency-score
description: The system outputs a detailed resiliency score as a single-line JSON object, facilitating easy aggregation across multiple test scenarios.

name: disable-resiliency-score
description: Disables resiliency score calculation entirely

name: resiliency-file
description: Path to a YAML file containing SLO definitions for resiliency scoring, defaults to the alerts profile or config/alerts.yaml

name: triggers
description: Group containing chaos trigger conditions and timing configuration options

name: trigger-command
description: Shell command to evaluate before chaos starts. Chaos begins only after this command exits with the expected code. Leave empty to disable triggers.

name: trigger-expected-rc
description: Expected shell command exit code for the trigger to be considered satisfied

name: triggers-mode
description: How multiple trigger conditions are combined

name: triggers-timeout
description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for trigger conditions before applying on-timeout behavior

name: triggers-interval
description: Polling interval in seconds while waiting for trigger conditions

name: triggers-on-timeout
description: Behavior when trigger conditions are not met before timeout

name: trigger-http-url
description: URL to poll for the HTTP trigger

name: trigger-http-method
description: HTTP method to use (GET, POST, etc.)

name: trigger-http-expected-status
description: Expected HTTP status code

name: trigger-http-bearer-token
description: Bearer token for HTTP authentication

name: trigger-http-body-contains
description: Substring expected in the HTTP response body

name: trigger-k8s-api-version
description: Kubernetes API version for the resource to watch (e.g. apps/v1, kubevirt.io/v1). Required when using a k8s trigger condition.

name: trigger-k8s-kind
description: Kubernetes resource kind to watch (e.g. Deployment, Pod, VirtualMachineInstanceMigration)

name: trigger-k8s-namespace
description: Namespace of the resource to watch. Leave empty for cluster-scoped resources like Nodes.

name: trigger-k8s-name
description: Name of the specific Kubernetes resource to watch

name: trigger-k8s-condition
description: Condition expression to evaluate against the resource (e.g. status.phase == Running, status.readyReplicas >= 1)

name: trigger-prom-query
description: PromQL expression for the prometheus trigger. Chaos begins only after the query returns a non-empty result. Leave empty to disable.

name: trigger-prom-url
description: Prometheus API URL used by the prometheus trigger condition. Required when trigger-prom-query is set.

name: trigger-prom-token
description: Optional bearer token for authenticating the prometheus trigger against prometheus-url
